meaning:
στρατιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;]
1. = στρατός, an army, a host: of angels (3Ki.22:19, al.), Luk.2:13; of the stars of heaven (Jer.8:2, 2Ch.33:3), Act.7:42.
2. As sometimes in cl. (poët.), = στρατεία: 2Co.10:4, T (WH, RV, στρατεία).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
But God turned, and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices…
